title: Career Roadmap · Solar Technician
summary: A Solar Technician installs, tests, maintains and troubleshoots solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, including panels, wiring, inverters, mounting structures and associated electrical equipment.

facts.Current degree: ITI Solar Technician / Solar PV Technician / related electrical and renewable-energy training

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 for eligible ITI pathways; Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics can broaden technical diploma and degree options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science is useful for advanced engineering routes; it is not universally required for vocational entry.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Basic electricity, circuits, solar energy, electrical safety, batteries and energy efficiency.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Mathematics, practical problem-solving, tool handling, teamwork and safety awareness.

blocks.label: Year 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Electrical basics, solar PV principles, components, tool use and safety.

blocks.label: Year 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Panel mounting, wiring, inverter connections, testing and fault identification under supervision.

blocks.label: Year 3 — Advanced practice
blocks.text: System sizing, performance checks, preventive maintenance and on-site troubleshooting.

blocks.label: Year 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Build a practical project portfolio, learn installation documentation and prepare for jobs or further study.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Previous qualifications, mathematics or science prerequisites for some technical programs, language proficiency where required, and institution-specific tests or experience. Verify current course and admission requirements through official institution websites.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Solar Installer, PV Technician, Solar Maintenance Technician, Electrical Technician and Solar Field Service Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Rooftop PV, utility-scale solar farms, battery storage and renewable-energy services.

blocks.label: Typical pathway

blocks.text: Local electrical licensing and safety requirements may apply. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

CLASS 10 ↓ ITI SOLAR TECHNICIAN (ELECTRICAL) OR ELIGIBLE ELECTRICAL TRADE ↓ ELECTRICAL + SOLAR PV SKILLS ↓ PRACTICAL INSTALLATION + SAFETY TRAINING ↓ APPRENTICESHIP / FIELD EXPERIENCE ↓ SOLAR INSTALLATION OR O&M TECHNICIAN ↓ ADVANCED TRAINING / DIPLOMA ↓ SUPERVISION / SPECIALIZATION / SOLAR BUSINESS

Verify current official notifications for course admissions, scholarships, training eligibility and electrical-safety requirements. Prioritize hands-on experience, safe working practices and supervised installation work.
